raw.title: Treaty of Amiens
raw.description: 1802 Treaty during the War of the Second Coalition
raw.extract: The Treaty of Amiens was a peace treaty signed between the French First Republic, Spain and Batavian Republic on one side and the United Kingdom on the other side in 1802. Signed on 27 March in the Hôtel de Ville of Amiens by Joseph Bonaparte for France and Lord Cornwallis for Britain, the treaty ended the ongoing War of the Second Coalition and marked the end of the French Revolutionary Wars, which had begun in 1792.
